declarations.description:
A postal address input that shows the parts each country's format needs, in its order, with its labels: a ZIP code
and a state for the United States, a postcode and an optional county for the United Kingdom, postal code and
prefecture first for Japan. About 40 countries have a format of their own; any other gets a general one.

The country picker lists the countries with a format (`countries` changes the list), named in the page's language.
Changing country keeps the parts both formats share. Required parts and the postal-code pattern are checked when a
part is left and when the form is submitted; each part shows its own message, and the form does not submit while
one is wrong. With a `name`, the form receives `name[line1]`, `name[city]`, `name[postalCode]`… and `name[country]`.

With a `provider`, the first line suggests addresses as it is typed, and picking one fills every part.
`googlePlacesProvider` and `mapboxSearchProvider`, exported with the element, wrap Google Places and Mapbox,
sending what is typed to them; without a provider nothing leaves the page. `formatAddress()` prints a saved address
in the country's postal order.

The parts are a group named by `label` (or the label of a `c2-form-field` around it), each part with its own label
and the browser's `autocomplete` token. Browsers do
not autofill fields inside a shadow root, which a provider makes up for.

members.name: value
members.description: The address. Set it as an object, or as JSON on the attribute.

members.name: country
members.description: The country to start with, when `value` has none.

members.name: countries
members.description: The countries offered, as ISO codes; every country with a format when empty.

members.name: name
members.description: The form field name: the form receives `name[part]` for each part.

members.name: label
members.description: The group's accessible name; "Address" by default.

members.name: required
members.description: The address must be given; otherwise it may be left empty, but once started, the country's required parts are.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns every part off; a disabled address is not submitted.

members.name: provider
members.description: An address search service for the first line.

members.name: field
members.description: In a `c2-form-field`, its label names the group and its hint and error describe it.

members.name: address
members.description: The address, with every part as a string.

members.name: complete
members.description: Whether every part the country needs is filled and valid.

members.name: errors

type.text: { part: AddressPart; message: string; missing: boolean }[]

members.description: The parts that are wrong, in the order shown. `all` checks every required part, touched or not.

members.name: pick
members.description: Fills the address from a suggestion.
